Libraries are dynamically linked. License texts are preserved in Qt/.
Versioned upstream license source URLs and file hashes are in sources.json.

MinGW 13.1 runtime (libstdc++, libgcc, winpthreads)
Upstream license/copyright files shipped with the compiler are preserved in MinGW/.
The GCC runtime exception text is included as MinGW/gcc/COPYING.RUNTIME.

No Windows system font files are redistributed in this package.
The application source code is delivered separately in the source archive.
